_: ABC の 島 (ABC Island). One big block house — walk in and「ABC と おと」opens (client/dist/abc.js). The letters, sounds, questions and answers are not here: the room builds and judges them (server/src/game/abc.js). Coordinates are relative to the island's own x/z. Colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers.
